items.title: 3.4.2 Radical Equations Reducible to the Quadratic Equation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein variable denominator mein tha; aaj variable square root ke andar baitha hai. Aisi equations ko radical equations kehte hain (radical yani root ka nishan \(\sqrt{\ }\)). In ka ilaaj hai square karna, kyun ke square aur square root ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain. Lekin is ilaaj ka ek "side effect" hai: kabhi kabhi aise jawab bhi aa jate hain jo asal equation ke hal nahin hote. Aaj hum yahi seekhenge ke unhein pehchaana aur nikaala kaise jaye.

Kitab ki definition: jin equations mein variable ki radical expressions (root wali expressions) hon, unhein radical equations kehte hain. Radical equation hal karne ke liye pehle hum aisi equation haasil karte hain jo radicals se azaad ho.

Kitab aage kehti hai: radical equation ka har solution radical-free (root ke baghair wali) equation ka bhi solution hota hai, lekin nayi equation ke kuch aise solutions bhi ho sakte hain jo asal radical equation ke solutions nahin hote. Aise zaaid (extra) solutions (roots) ko extraneous roots kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Square karne se faltu roots kyun paida hote hain? Agar \(p = q\) ho to yaqeenan \(p^{2} = q^{2}\). Lekin ulta sach nahin: \(p^{2} = q^{2}\) ka matlab hai \(p = q\) YA \(p = -q\). Square karne ke baad yeh pata hi nahin chalta ke asal mein kaun sa case tha.
Chhoti si misaal: \(x = 3\) ka sirf ek hal hai. Iska square lein: \(x^{2} = 9\), jis ke do hal hain, \(3\) aur \(-3\). Yeh \(-3\) naya mehmaan hai jo asal equation mein tha hi nahin. Isi ko extraneous root kehte hain.
Is liye har radical equation ka aakhri qadam ASAL equation mein check karna hai, square wali equation mein nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Radical equation hal karne ka tareeqa:
1. Sharait note karein: har square root ke andar wali expression \(\ge 0\) ho.
2. Mumkin ho to ek radical ko ek taraf akela karein.
3. Dono sides ka square lein. Agar koi radical bach jaye to use akela kar ke dobara square karein.
4. Simplify kar ke \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) banayein aur hal karein.
5. Har value asal equation mein rakhein; jo satisfy na kare (extraneous root) use reject karein.
Is tareeqe ko aise yaad rakhiye: "akela karo, square karo, hal karo, check karo".
Ab kitab ki misaal dekhte hain, jis mein do dafa square karna parta hai aur ek extraneous root bhi nikalta hai.

blocks.title: Example 8
steps:
Given: \(\sqrt{x+8} + \sqrt{x+3} = \sqrt{12x+13}\).
To find: solution set.
Method: yeh radical equation hai, kyun ke variable square roots ke andar hai. Plan: dono sides ka square lenge taa ke roots hatein. Ek radical term phir bhi bachega, us ko akela kar ke dobara square karenge. Phir quadratic banegi. Aur kyun ke square karne se extraneous (faltu) roots paida ho sakte hain, har jawab asal equation mein check karna lazmi hai.

Step 1: Sharait note karein
Har square root ke andar wali expression \(\ge 0\) honi chahiye:
\[x + 8 \ge 0,\ \ x + 3 \ge 0\]
\[12x + 13 \ge 0\]
Kyun: negative number ka square root real number nahin hota. Yeh sharait batati hain ke kaun si values jawab ban sakti hain aur kaun si shuru se hi nahin.

Step 2: Dono sides ka square lein
Left side par formula \((p + q)^{2} = p^{2} + 2pq + q^{2}\) lagayein, jahan \(p = \sqrt{x+8}\), \(q = \sqrt{x+3}\):
\[x + 8 + x + 3 + 2\sqrt{x+8}\sqrt{x+3}\]
\[= 12x + 13\]
Kyun: square aur square root ek doosre ko khatam karte hain: \((\sqrt{x+8})^{2} = x + 8\). Lekin beech wala term \(2pq\) abhi bhi root rakhta hai, is liye kaam abhi khatam nahin hua.
Dhyan dein: \((\sqrt{x+8} + \sqrt{x+3})^{2}\) ko \((x+8) + (x+3)\) likh dena sab se aam ghalti hai. Jama ka square alag alag square ka jama NAHIN hota; beech wala \(2pq\) zaroor aata hai. Jaise \((2+3)^{2} = 25\), jab ke \(4 + 9 = 13\).

Step 3: Radical term ko akela karein
\[2x + 11 + 2\sqrt{x+8}\sqrt{x+3} = 12x + 13\]
\[2\sqrt{x+8}\sqrt{x+3} = 10x + 2\]
2 se divide karein aur dono roots ko jor dein:
\[\sqrt{(x+8)(x+3)} = 5x + 1\]
Kyun: dobara square karne se pehle radical ko ek taraf akela karna zaroori hai, warna square karne par root phir wapas aa jayega. \(\sqrt{a}\sqrt{b} = \sqrt{ab}\) yahan sahi hai kyun ke \(a, b \ge 0\) hain.
Ek baat zehan mein rakhiye: left side ek square root hai, jo kabhi negative nahin hota. Is liye asal jawab ke liye \(5x + 1 \ge 0\) bhi hona chahiye. Yeh baat aakhir mein kaam aayegi.

Step 4: Dobara square karein
\[(x+8)(x+3) = (5x+1)^{2}\]
\[x^{2} + 11x + 24 = 25x^{2} + 10x + 1\]
Kyun: ab equation mein koi root nahin raha. Left side: \(x^{2} + 3x + 8x + 24\). Right side: \((5x)^{2} + 2(5x)(1) + 1^{2}\).

Step 5: Standard form
\[25x^{2} - x^{2} + 10x - 11x + 1 - 24 = 0\]
\[24x^{2} - x - 23 = 0\]
Kyun: saare terms us taraf le gaye jahan \(x^{2}\) bara hai, taa ke \(a\) positive rahe. Positive \(a\) ke saath factorise karna aasan rehta hai.

Step 6: Factorise karein
\(ac = 24 \times (-23) = -552\). Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-552\) aur jama \(-1\) ho: woh \(-24\) aur \(23\) hain.
\[24x^{2} - 24x + 23x - 23 = 0\]
\[24x(x - 1) + 23(x - 1) = 0\]
\[(24x + 23)(x - 1) = 0\]
\[x = -\dfrac{23}{24} \ \text{ya}\ x = 1\]
Kyun: middle term ko tor kar (splitting) common factor \((x - 1)\) nikal aata hai. Lekin yaad rakhiye, yeh abhi sirf "ummeedwar" (candidates) hain; faisla check karega.

Tasdeeq: dono values asal equation mein rakhein
\(x = 1\) ke liye:
\[\sqrt{9} + \sqrt{4} = 3 + 2 = 5\]
\[\sqrt{12 + 13} = \sqrt{25} = 5\]
Dono sides 5, is liye \(x = 1\) sahi jawab hai.
\(x = -\frac{23}{24}\) ke liye: \(x + 8 = \frac{169}{24}\), \(x + 3 = \frac{49}{24}\), \(12x + 13 = \frac{3}{2}\).
\[\text{LHS} = \dfrac{13}{\sqrt{24}} + \dfrac{7}{\sqrt{24}} \approx 4.08\]
\[\text{RHS} = \sqrt{\dfrac{3}{2}} \approx 1.22\]
Dono sides barabar nahin, is liye \(x = -\frac{23}{24}\) extraneous root hai, use reject karte hain.
Yeh faltu root aaya kahan se? Step 3 mein left side \(\sqrt{(x+8)(x+3)}\) kabhi negative nahin hoti, lekin \(x = -\frac{23}{24}\) par right side \(5x + 1 = -\frac{91}{24}\) negative hai. Square karne se yeh sign ka farq chhup gaya, kyun ke \((-3)^{2}\) aur \(3^{2}\) dono 9 hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari apni chhoti misaal hai (kitab ka sawal nahin): \(\sqrt{x+2} = x\).
Square karein: \(x + 2 = x^{2}\), yani \(x^{2} - x - 2 = 0\), \((x - 2)(x + 1) = 0\), to \(x = 2\) ya \(x = -1\).
Check \(x = 2\): \(\sqrt{4} = 2\). Sahi.
Check \(x = -1\): \(\sqrt{1} = 1\), lekin right side \(-1\) hai. \(1 \ne -1\), is liye extraneous.
Solution set \(= \{2\}\).
Ek fauri test: agar equation \(\sqrt{\ \ } = \) (koi expression) ki shakal mein ho, to sahi jawab par right side wali expression \(\ge 0\) honi chahiye, kyun ke square root kabhi negative nahin hota.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\sqrt{x} = -2\) ka koi real hal hai? Square karein to \(x = 4\) milta hai, lekin \(\sqrt{4} = 2\), \(-2\) nahin. To jawab: koi hal nahin, solution set khali hai. Isi liye check zaroori hai!

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Har ummeedwar value ka check asal equation mein likh kar dikhayein, aur aakhir mein saaf jumla likhein, jaise "\(-\frac{23}{24}\) is an extraneous root". Check par number milte hain, aur jo jawab extraneous root ko bhi rakhe woh ghalat mana jata hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Radical equation mein variable root ke nishan ke andar hota hai.
2. Radicals ko akela kar ke square karne se hatate hain (kabhi kabhi do dafa).
3. Square karne se extraneous roots paida ho sakte hain: yeh squared equation ko to satisfy karte hain, asal ko nahin.
4. Har value asal equation mein check karein; sirf wohi rakhein jo poori utrein.
5. Example 8 ka jawab: \(\{1\}\); \(-\frac{23}{24}\) extraneous hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \((\sqrt{a} + \sqrt{b})^{2} = a + b\) likh dena: beech wala term \(2\sqrt{a}\sqrt{b}\) ghaib ho jata hai. Hamesha \((p + q)^{2}\) ka poora formula lagayein.
2. Radical ko akela kiye baghair square kar dena; phir root wapas aa jata hai aur kaam lamba ho jata hai.
3. Check na karna aur extraneous root ko bhi jawab mein likh dena.
4. Check squared equation mein karna: woh to dono values se satisfy ho jati hai, is liye ghalti pakri nahin jati. Check hamesha asal equation mein.
